about:
Y3 Business AI System student from NUS (as of AY25/26 if i dont update this regularly). I enjoy building software to solve problems I am having and share some of it that i think is useful. 

I am experienced in leading groups and discussion from my days in the military, president of NUS Origami and group lead. Worked as a part time Teaching Assistant in the National University of Singapore for a year.

Current interest includes origami (obviously), electronic project, 3D printing where I am learning during my free time. I am interested in learning more about AI and ML to apply into my projects to improve / benefit in some way.

Also a peer student supporter of NUS School of Computing, where we aim to provide mental and social support amongst the students by holding events and talking to students.
